statement: Per-node serve eligibility is one fact with one owner: the control-plane readiness owner answers it from a committed read of the nodes rows (status, boot incarnation, ready lease) and the latest published control_plane_publications row (publication epoch, published active nodes, priority spread) taken on the raft leaders of those system partitions, as {decision, epoch} or a typed UNAVAILABLE{reason, epoch, retryAfterMs}; the readiness snapshot is a memo keyed by that epoch and a stale memo answers UNAVAILABLE_STALE{epoch}. User-table routing, CREATE TABLE provisioning (complete at the sealed quorum minimum with a typed under_replicated outcome naming the epoch and missing count, or PROVISIONING_UNAVAILABLE mapped to SQLSTATE 57P03), the rebalancer's critical-topology settle, available-node and local-serve decisions, the in-flight operations source and the learner count check consume that answer or the committed lease it is built from. System-table routing decides on raft leadership and live transport, never on serve eligibility, so no readiness carve-out is needed. Deleted: the system-table leader fail-open and its inline evidence-absent set, readiness-denial-classification.js, the priority-recovery bootstrap routing bypass and its read lane, the fresh-bootstrap routing grace, every !== false and empty-means-satisfied default on a readiness input, allowStaleOnCacheChange and maxCachedAgeMs on decision paths, the degraded provisioning fallback, the provisioning convergence poll and its 10 s constant, the transient-shortfall minimum lowering, and the CACHE source of in-flight topology operations. On a fresh three-node formation the serve lane opens on every node.

constraints.statement: Instances C5, C6, C7, C11 and C12's readiness input of the class 'a serve-gating decision consumes a projection of committed state as if it were the authority' (census solve/epics/raft-rs-full-cutover/evidence/projection-authority-census-2026-11-02/CENSUS.md on origin/work/projection-authority-census-20261102; analysis docs/evidence/comparative-benchmark-evidence-repair-2026-11/systemic-analysis-serve-lane-2026-11-01.md sections 3-4). The repair moves each decision onto the committed fact and deletes the alternate paths; it adds no timer constant, poll, retry widening, carve-out, fallback, alias, compatibility path, cache/SQL dual path, or default that turns a missing input into a satisfied one.

Continues owner decisions O1/A8 (committed-membership bootstrap read, 2026-09-25/26) and the learner quest: rows in SystemTableCache are discovery and reconciliation triggers, never the authority for a gating decision. A cache event may mark the epoch memo stale and start a committed refresh; it never grants.

Lead decision F10 (2026-11-02, under the owner brief of 2026-11-02, reported to the owner for confirmation): CREATE TABLE completes when the committed cohort at the stated epoch reaches the sealed quorum minimum and answers contractState under_replicated with the epoch and missing replica count (client NOTICE and admin envelope); below quorum it answers PROVISIONING_UNAVAILABLE{epoch, reasons, retryAfterMs} mapped to SQLSTATE 57P03 through SQLSTATE_BY_ENGINE_ERROR_CODE. An owner reversal is recorded as an R09 supersession of this constraint.

R09 supersessions recorded by appending at the owner's location, never by editing recorded text: architecture/runtime-contracts.md 'CDC-propagated metadata decisions read from the cache' for gating decisions; architecture/readiness-and-owner-contracts.md 'Readiness Gating (repairEligible vs serveEligible)' including the self-readiness timed-out-reporter preservation; the sealed CL-033 5 s staleness bound implemented by allowStaleOnCacheChange/maxCachedAgeMs; and the Q6 record (solve/epics/core-architecture-convergence/readiness-observation-currency.md) slices this quest subsumes.

The scenario receipt is measured on the registered scenario fresh-formation-user-table-routability (local-three-node.json, predicates in test/distributed/harness/fresh-formation-routability-predicate.js) with its preregistered bounds unchanged, after the parallel quest replica-admission-from-committed-operation (C1/C10) has landed; no bound is widened, no harness write repairs product state, and serve eligibility is not bypassed for user tables.

Red first at the unit level per attempt with the first failing assertion recorded; the readiness-versioned-planning-liveness impact contract and the Q6 wide net on lab hosts per attempt; the live scenario red before and green after on lab hosts with node logs retained; independent verification before landing.

Stream B owns src/cdc/cdc-integration-service-cache-visibility-wait.js, its callers and the CACHE_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT retry classification in src/query/sql-query-engine-shared.js; Stream B2 owns replica-create admission and the participant release/cutover owners; Group B owns peer and leader address resolution. This quest edits none of their files; a collision is reported to the lead, not resolved here.
Any source change is verified on the exact candidate by a fresh independent verifier before landing, recorded as note --verification ... --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve.
